citations.assessment: The receiving Menaḥma entry explicitly places Naḥman of Jaffa in the name of Yaakov of Caesarea. The Yaakov entry independently repeats that name; maintain Neḥemyah in this entry.

holds.reason: The internal entries corroborate the direction but use Naḥman, while this entry has Neḥemyah. The exact underlying witness for this form is unlocated.
